statuses.technical_meaning: A valid itinerary exists within the fixed snapshot and constraints.
statuses.what_is_not_known: Real operation, punctuality, entrance and appointment availability are not known.
statuses.allowed_user_facing_meaning: Se encontró un itinerario programado/modelado en este alcance.

statuses.technical_meaning: No pair meets all modeled constraints in the searched snapshot.
statuses.what_is_not_known: It does not prove that transport does not exist.
statuses.allowed_user_facing_meaning: No se encontró una pareja viable dentro del snapshot, paradas y restricciones modeladas.
statuses.safe_recovery: Change supported inputs or consult a broader planner.

error.message: Sin pareja viable en paradas/red admitidas

statuses.technical_meaning: The provider lacks validated evidence for the request, notably another date.
statuses.what_is_known: Requested value is outside validated evidence.
statuses.what_is_not_known: It does not prove no buses run.
statuses.allowed_user_facing_meaning: La fecha no está validada por este snapshot.
statuses.safe_recovery: Obtain a validated snapshot; never substitute 2026-09-29 silently.

statuses.technical_meaning: The request is outside declared catalog/capability.
statuses.what_is_known: The provider recognizes the request but cannot model it.
statuses.what_is_not_known: It is not an infrastructure failure.
statuses.allowed_user_facing_meaning: La petición queda fuera del alcance disponible.
statuses.safe_recovery: Use catalog IDs or obtain new scoped evidence.

error.message: Origen o destino fuera del catálogo sanitario

statuses.what_is_known: Validation failed before a journey claim.
statuses.what_is_not_known: It is not an HTTP/network timeout.
statuses.allowed_user_facing_meaning: La petición no tiene un formato o valor válido.
statuses.forbidden_inference: Fallo de red o ausencia de servicio.

relative_date_policy.rule: Resolve to a real date. If it is not 2026-09-29, pass it unchanged; never silently substitute the validated date.
